summary: This is an 8-K filed by GSR V Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, reporting the consummation of its initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit for gross proceeds of $230 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-seventh of a right. The filing also covers standard IPO agreements (underwriting, trust, letter agreements) and related corporate actions. This is a routine current report for a SPAC IPO, not a special situation like a business combination or other event.
